spec_match.rationale: Shows the native typed-<source> ladder and which rung the browser commits to, but the chromestatus entry ships IAMF through MSE; the page should say how the <source> path relates to that.

interactive.rationale: Ladder select and "Build the element" both changed the chosen-rung output and the real <audio> element's fetch record.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the degradation ladder angle the index describes.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unreached vs unsupported rungs; does not show the all-rungs-unsupported fallback text being rendered.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 6/6 PASS here and pairs the IAMF strings with a known-good control and an invented codec, so a negative cannot come from a broken probe.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): building the element produced 3 console errors and 3 failed requests (404 /media/concert.iamf.flac.mp4, /media/concert.iamf.mp4, /media/concert.stereo.mp4) — the files intentionally do not exist.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360px mobile emulation the layout viewport widens to 412px: the long codecs string in the chosen-rung <code>/<span class="picked"> does not wrap.

openQuestions.title: Stop the demo from generating 404s and console errors
openQuestions.detail: The real <audio> element is pointed at /media/*.mp4 URLs that do not exist, so every run logs three "Failed to load resource: 404" errors and three failed requests, which violates the zero-console-error / no-failed-request bar and pollutes telemetry. Serve the rungs from a tiny server route under the feature folder that returns a valid (or deliberately empty 204) response and records which URL was requested, and read the fetch order from that route or Resource Timing.

openQuestions.title: Fix 52px horizontal overflow at 360px
openQuestions.detail: documentElement.scrollWidth is 412 at a 360px mobile viewport; the culprit is the unbroken audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.000.000.fLaC" string inside the chosen-rung line. Add overflow-wrap: anywhere (or word-break) on the ladder code spans, then re-run deno task responsive-check for this demo.
